query: BEGIN; DO $$ DECLARE v_student_id uuid; v_offering_id uuid; v_grade_id uuid := 'c1020000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'; v_seen integer; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_student_id FROM public.profiles WHERE role='student' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1; SELECT o.id INTO v_offering_id FROM public.course_subject_offerings o JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name='A1' AND s.name='Français' LIMIT 1; IF v_student_id IS NULL OR v_offering_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Précondition de test manquante'; END IF; PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', v_student_id::text, true); PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.role', 'authenticated', true); EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated'; INSERT INTO public.edutech_grades(id,student_id,subject_offering_id,subject_label_legacy,school_year,term,assessment_type,grade,max_grade,assessment_coefficient,assessment_date,include_in_average,created_by_student) VALUES (v_grade_id,v_student_id,v_offering_id,'Français','2026-2027','T1','devoir_classe',15,20,2,'2026-08-16',true,true); UPDATE public.edutech_grades AS g SET assessment_coefficient=1 WHERE g.id=v_grade_id AND g.student_id=v_student_id; SELECT count(*) INTO v_seen FROM public.edutech_grades AS g WHERE g.id=v_grade_id AND g.student_id=v_student_id AND g.assessment_coefficient=1; IF v_seen <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modification propriétaire refusée'; END IF; DELETE FROM public.edutech_grades AS g WHERE g.id=v_grade_id AND g.student_id=v_student_id; SELECT count(*) INTO v_seen FROM public.edutech_grades AS g WHERE g.id=v_grade_id; IF v_seen <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Suppression propriétaire refusée'; END IF; END $$; ROLLBACK;
